description: Verify an Idemcore receipt without calling the API: L1 checks format and the Ed25519 signature against trusted Idemcore keys; L2 recomputes the token-log chain digests from a log; optional disclosure checks that a prompt, token ids or displayed text match the receipt's hashes.

extra_keys.description: Extra public JWK / JWKS to trust for this call (e.g. a self-hosted signer).

log_path.description: Path to a per-token log file for L2.

messages.description: Disclosed prompt messages to check against prompt_hash.

output_ids.description: Disclosed output token ids to check against output_token_hash.

output_text.description: Displayed answer text to check against output_text_hash (if the receipt carries it).

receipt.description: Receipt JSON (object, JSON string, base64url JSON, or an embed envelope {receipt, ...}).

salt_b64u.description: Salt (base64url) for hash_only receipts; not needed for privacy=full.

name: idemcore_verify_receipt
title: Verify a receipt offline
